stem:
【概要写作】阅读下面短文，用约 60 词写一篇内容概要，不加入个人评论。
Walking is one of the simplest forms of exercise, and doctors increasingly recommend it. Studies show that a thirty-minute walk five times a week strengthens the heart, helps control weight and improves sleep. Unlike gym training, walking needs no equipment and carries little risk of injury. However, experts point out that pace matters: a brisk walk brings far greater benefits than a slow stroll. Therefore, health advisers suggest building walking into daily routines, such as getting off the bus one stop early.
answer: 参考概要（约 62 词）：Doctors increasingly recommend walking as simple, safe exercise. Research shows that regular thirty-minute brisk walks improve the heart, weight control and sleep. Unlike gym training, walking costs nothing and seldom causes injury. Since pace determines the benefit, experts advise making brisk walking part of everyday life, for example by walking part of the journey to work.
solution: 概述按“对象与主张—依据与益处—条件与建议”三步压缩：保留 doctors recommend、研究结论、与健身房训练的对比、pace 条件与日常化建议，删去具体例子。

stem: 【应用文写作·通知】学校英语协会将举办英语演讲比赛，请你以协会名义用英语写一则通知（Notice），内容包括：比赛时间与地点、报名方式与截止日期、对观众的要求。词数 80 左右。
answer:
参考范文：
Notice
An English speech contest will be held in the school lecture hall at 3:00 p.m. on Friday, 20 October. Those who wish to take part, please sign up at the office of the English Association or email us at englishclub@school.com before 15 October. The top three winners will be awarded prizes. Everyone is welcome to come and cheer for the speakers. Please arrive ten minutes early and keep quiet during the contest.
The English Association
solution: 应用文“通知”三要素：标题 Notice、正文（时间地点—报名方式与截止—观众要求）、落款；要点齐全、格式规范、语气得体，词数约 80。

stem: 高考英语笔试共 120 分钟。考试进行到 90 分钟时，你发现书面表达（25 分）尚未动笔，而完形填空还剩 8 个空没做完。此时按“性价比”最优的做法是（　　）
options: A. 先花 15 分钟把完形全部做完，剩下的时间能写多少作文算多少
B. 立即转到书面表达，先花约 8 分钟列提纲、再用约 18 分钟成文誊写，剩余时间回头补完形
C. 放弃书面表达，把全部剩余时间用来检查已答题目
D. 维持原答题顺序慢慢做完形，作文写不完就算了
answer: B
solution: 分值性价比：书面表达 25 分远高于 8 个完形空（约 1.5 分/空）。应优先保证高分值题目完整成文，并预留誊写时间；A、D 可能丢掉大分，C 直接放弃 25 分，均不合理。

stem: 【考试时间规划·填空】按“先易后难、留足检查”的原则补全你的 120 分钟答题计划：听力 20 分钟；阅读理解约 35 分钟；语言运用（完形填空+语法填空）约 ____ 分钟；写作约 40 分钟；考试结束前必须预留至少 ____ 分钟用于填涂答题卡并核对有无漏题。
answer: 25；5（语言运用约 25 分钟，则 20+35+25+40=120；结束前至少预留 5 分钟填涂答题卡并核对漏题。只要各部分之和为 120 分钟且预留了合理检查时间，即可视为正确）
solution: 总时长 120 分钟，四大部分时间之和须等于 120；涂卡与查漏是“必做动作”，须固定预留约 5 分钟，避免交卷前慌乱漏涂。

stem: 下列做法中，最能体现“持久的英语学习动力与自主学习能力”的是（　　）
options: A. 只在考试前一周突击背单词
B. 只在老师布置作业时才接触英语
C. 三年来每天用英语听一段新闻并做笔记，遇到不懂的主动查证
D. 觉得自己口语差，从此再也不开口说英语
answer: C
solution: “持久动力+自主学习”体现为长期坚持、主动创造练习机会并自我查证；A 突击、B 被动、D 回避，均与该素养相悖。

stem: 【学习计划·表达】高三学习紧张，仍要“创造和把握多种机会练习和运用英语”。请用英语写一份一周英语自主学习微计划（不少于 40 词），至少包含三种嵌入日常生活的练习机会（如通勤听、课间读、睡前写等）。
answer: 参考范文：Here is my weekly micro-plan. I will listen to English news for ten minutes on my way to school every day. During the ten-minute break, I will read one short English article. Before bed, I will write three sentences in English about my day. At weekends, I will watch an English film without subtitles and retell the story to my deskmate.
solution: 微计划的关键是“小步、可坚持、嵌入日常”：三个时机（通勤/课间/睡前）+一个周末任务，任务量小而具体，才能长期坚持，体现持久学习动力。

stem: 关于“理性自觉地总结适合自己的英语学习方法”，下列做法最恰当的是（　　）
options: A. 每次考试后分析错题分布，记录所用方法的效果，保留有效做法、调整低效做法
B. 别人用什么方法，我就照搬什么方法
C. 从初一起就一直用同一套方法，从不反思调整
D. 认为学习方法没有用，学得好坏全靠天赋
answer: A
solution: 理性总结方法=用证据（错题分布、效果记录）检验方法，再做保留/调整的决策；B 盲从他人、C 拒绝反思、D 否定方法的作用，都不属于理性自觉的方法总结。

stem: 【方法总结·表达】请用英语总结你认为最有效的英语听力训练方法，说明步骤与理由（不少于 50 词），要求出现 first、next、finally 之类的步骤词。
answer: 参考范文：My most effective method for listening training is shadowing. First, I listen to a short recording without the script to get the main idea. Next, I listen again and repeat sentence by sentence, imitating the pronunciation and intonation. Finally, I check the script, mark the parts I missed and listen once more. It works because it trains my ears, my mouth and my attention at the same time.
solution: 方法总结的结构=方法名+分步操作（first/next/finally）+理由（because...）；步骤词使表达条理清晰，体现对自身方法的理性概括。

stem: 【即兴演讲】你抽到即兴演讲题 “The power of a smile”，准备 1 分钟，演讲约 1 分钟（80—100 词）。请先写出演讲提纲（观点+两个支撑点+结尾），再写出演讲稿。
answer:
提纲：观点—A smile costs nothing but changes everything；支撑 1—微笑拉近人与人的距离（例：向新同学微笑成为好友）；支撑 2—微笑给自己力量（例：考试失利后微笑面对、重新开始）；结尾—号召大家每天带着微笑。
演讲稿：Good morning, everyone. Have you ever noticed how one smile can change a whole day? I believe a smile costs nothing but changes everything. First, a smile brings people closer. Last term I smiled at a new student, and we soon became best friends. Second, a smile gives us strength. When I failed a maths test, a smile helped me start again instead of giving up. So let us wear a smile every day, because it is the shortest distance between two hearts. Thank you.
solution: 即兴演讲结构：钩子（设问）—观点—两个支撑（各配一个亲身事例）—号召式结尾；先用提纲固定结构，再用口语化语言展开，条理清楚、语言准确。

stem: 即兴演讲只给 1 分钟准备时间。下列准备策略中最有效的是（　　）
options: A. 用全部准备时间逐字写稿，上台照着念
B. 快速写下观点关键词、两个例子和一句结尾，上台据此口头扩展
C. 什么都不准备，上台后想到哪里说到哪里
D. 反复修改第一句话的措辞，直到完美再考虑其他内容
answer: B
solution: 即兴演讲的评分点是结构与要点覆盖，关键词提纲最省时且保留现场感；A 逐字稿既来不及又导致照读，C 无结构，D 因小失大。

stem: 【主题写作·生命意义】有人认为人生的意义在于取得成就（achievements），有人认为在于奉献（contribution）。请用英语写一段 80 词左右的短文，表明你的观点，并给出至少两条理由和一个具体事例。
answer: 参考范文：In my opinion, a meaningful life lies more in contribution than in achievements. Achievements make us proud, but they only light our own lamps, while contribution lights others'. My neighbour, a retired doctor, volunteers at a community clinic every weekend. She has won no prizes for it, yet hundreds of families are healthier because of her. When she talks about her patients, her eyes shine brighter than any medal. Therefore, what makes life valuable is not what we gain, but what we give.
solution: 生命意义主题的议论段=亮明观点+对比说理（成就 vs 奉献）+具体事例（退休医生志愿服务）+回扣观点；价值判断须有事例与理由支撑。

stem:
【主题阅读·生命意义与生涯规划】阅读短文，回答问题。
At twenty-five, Michael gave up a well-paid job in a bank and trained to be a rural teacher. His friends laughed at him, saying he was throwing his talent away. Five years later, his students' village school has produced its first university students, and Michael says he has never felt richer. “Success is not about the salary on your payslip,” he explains, “but about the lives you touch.”
问题：Which of the following best states the value judgement the passage supports?
options: A. A high salary is the only measure of a successful career.
B. Rural teachers always earn more than bank workers.
C. A meaningful career is judged by one's contribution to others rather than by money.
D. Young people should avoid working in banks.
answer: C
solution: 抓住人物的取舍与直接引语 “not about the salary ... but about the lives you touch”，可判断语篇支持“以对他人的贡献衡量职业价值”；A 与文意相反，B 无依据，D 过度推断。

stem: 【创造性写作·五行诗】以 “Light” 为题创作一首五行小诗，要求：第 1 行一个名词；第 2 行两个形容词；第 3 行三个 -ing 形式的动词；第 4 行一个表达感受的短语；第 5 行一个与第 1 行呼应的同义词。示例（题为 Rain）：Rain / Soft, cool / Falling, drumming, whispering / A song on my roof / Shower.
answer:
参考答案：
Light
Warm, golden
Dancing, shining, warming
A kiss on my face
Sunshine
solution: 五行诗借助特殊的词汇形式（名词—形容词—-ing 动词序列）与分行版式创造意象；各行词性与题主要求对应，末行以同义词回扣主题即合格。

stem: 【创造性写作·海报标语】学校读书节需要一句创意英文标语（slogan）贴在海报上，并配一句说明。要求：标语不超过 8 个词，至少使用押韵、重复、双关三种手法之一；说明不超过 20 词。请写出标语与说明。
answer:
参考答案：
标语：Open a Book, Open the World.（运用重复手法：重复 open 形成排比冲击力）
说明：Every page you turn builds a bridge to somewhere new — come and read with us!
solution: 创造性语篇可借助修辞手法（重复/押韵/双关）与版式资源（大写、破折号、分行）增强感染力；标语短小有节奏，说明句点明活动召唤。

stem: 【演讲稿写作】你将参加校英语演讲比赛，题目为 “Youth Is the Time to Dare”。请写一篇 100—120 词的演讲稿，要求：开头用设问或引用吸引听众；中间用 First/Second 推进两点论证；结尾发出号召。
answer: 参考范文：“What would you attempt if you knew you could not fail?” Someone once asked me this question, and it changed me. Ladies and gentlemen, youth is the time to dare. First, daring expands our limits. When I first signed up for the 1,500-metre race, I could hardly finish one lap, yet I ended up winning a medal for my class. Second, daring turns failure into lessons. Every bold attempt, successful or not, teaches us more than staying safe ever could. So, my dear friends, do not let fear write your story. Dare to start, dare to stumble, and dare to begin again. Thank you!
solution: 演讲稿三要素：开头钩子（设问式引语）、正文分层推进（First/Second+亲身事例）、结尾排比号召；语言口语化、有节奏感，词数 100—120。

stem: 演讲稿 “Never Give Up” 的开头，最能起到“吸引听众”作用的一项是（　　）
options: A. Today my topic is “Never Give Up”. My speech has three parts.
B. Have you ever wanted to give up one step before success? Three years ago, I almost did.
C. Never giving up is a very important quality. Everyone should have it.
D. OK, now let me say something about never giving up.
answer: B
solution: 设问+悬念式开头制造代入感，把听众卷入话题；A 平铺直叙报流程，C 空洞说教，D 口语随意，吸引力都弱于 B。

stem:
【读后概述】阅读短文，用约 60 词概述其主要内容与作者观点。
Remote working, once a rare privilege, became routine for millions almost overnight. Supporters praise its flexibility: no commuting means more family time and, for many, higher productivity. Critics, however, warn of its hidden costs — weakened team spirit, blurred boundaries between work and rest, and the loneliness of days without face-to-face talk. The author concludes that remote working is neither paradise nor trap; its success depends on whether companies redesign management and individuals learn self-discipline.
answer: 参考概述（约 60 词）：The passage discusses the rise of remote working, which turned from a rare privilege into routine. While supporters value its flexibility and higher productivity, critics point to weaker team bonds, blurred work-rest boundaries and loneliness. The author concludes that remote working is neither paradise nor trap: its success depends on companies redesigning management and individuals practising self-discipline.
solution: 读后概述=话题（远程办公的兴起）+双方观点（支持者/批评者）+作者结论（成败取决于管理重构与自律）；压缩细节，保留观点结构，不加个人评论。

stem:
【读后概述·完成概述句】阅读短文，用不超过 25 词补全概述句，使概括符合语篇“现象—原因—对策”的结构。
City parks were once seen as decorations. Now planners treat them as infrastructure. As cities grow hotter and denser, green spaces cool streets, absorb rainwater and offer free places for exercise. Since land is limited, many cities are turning rooftops, old railway lines and riverbanks into parks. New York's High Line, a park built on a raised railway, attracts millions of visitors a year and has inspired similar projects worldwide.
概述句：The passage shows that ______（现象）, explains why green spaces matter（原因）, and illustrates how cities ______（对策）.
answer: 现象：city green spaces are now treated as important infrastructure rather than decoration；对策：create parks out of unused spaces such as rooftops and old railway lines（两处答出核心意思即可）
solution: 先判定语篇结构（现象：绿地被当作基础设施；原因：降温、吸水、锻炼；对策：利用屋顶、旧铁路等闲置空间建公园），再把两处信息压缩成概述句；例子（纽约高线公园）在概述中应省略。

stem: 听录音并跟读告别语 “Goodbye!” 时，句末通常使用的语调是（　　）
options: A. 升调 ↗
B. 降调 ↘
C. 平调 →
D. 先升后降
answer: B
solution: 告别语句末一般用降调，表示话语完整、语气自然；跟读模仿时要特别注意模仿录音的语调走向。

stem: 下列哪组小写字母是按字母表先后顺序排列的？（　　）
options: A. e, g, i
B. h, f, d
C. j, i, k
D. b, d, c
answer: A
solution: 字母表顺序 a b c d e f g h i j k…；A 项 e→g→i 依次靠后，正确；B 项倒序，C、D 两项中均有字母错位。

stem: 表演故事《拔萝卜》（The Enormous Turnip）时，你扮演 grandpa。萝卜拔不动，你想叫老奶奶来帮忙，请写出你的台词（不少于 3 个英文单词）：____
answer: 参考台词：Come here, Grandma! Please help me pull the turnip!（含呼语+请求，不少于 3 词即可，如 “Grandma, come and help me, please!” 亦可）
solution: 角色台词要符合情节需要：先称呼对方，再发出请求；用 come、please 等词表达求助，语气自然响亮。

stem: 班级开展“每周英语视听不少于 20 分钟”活动。请用英语写出你的视听安排（不少于 8 个英文词），写清每周几次、每次多长时间、看或听什么：____
answer: 参考答案：I watch English cartoons three times a week, and I watch for ten minutes every time.（示例：次数×每次时长不少于 20 分钟、说清视听内容即可，如 “I listen to English songs twice a week, fifteen minutes each time.”）
solution: 用频率短语（once/twice/three times a week）与时长（minutes）表达计划；核算“次数×每次时长≥20 分钟”即符合活动要求。

stem: 同伴问你：“What do you have for breakfast?” 最合适的回答是（　　）
options: A. I have bread and milk.
B. I have breakfast at seven.
C. It's six o'clock.
D. Yes, I do.
answer: A
solution: 问句问“早餐吃什么”，答语应给出食物；B 答的是吃早餐的时间，C 答的是几点钟，D 是 yes/no 回答，均与问句不匹配。

stem: 新年到了，请给你的好朋友写一张英文新年贺卡，至少 2 句（不少于 10 个英文词），格式：称呼 + 祝福 + 署名：____
answer:
参考答案：
Dear Amy,
Happy New Year! I miss you very much. I wish you a wonderful year.
Yours,
Lingling
solution: 贺卡三要素：称呼（Dear...）、祝福语（Happy New Year! + 一句愿望）、署名（Yours, + 名字）；句子简单完整、词数达标即可。

stem: 仿照例句 “There is a cat under the chair.” 写出一个含 There is 的句子，描述你的教室（不少于 5 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：There is a blackboard in my classroom.（示例：There is + 单数名词 + 地点介词短语，如 “There is a picture on the wall.” 亦可）
solution: 仿写只替换词汇、保留句型：There is + 单数名词 + in/on/under + 地点；注意名词前可加 a/the 及形容词。

stem: 下列句子的书写完全正确（大小写与标点）的一项是（　　）
options: A. i like english.
B. I like English.
C. I like english
D. i Like English?
answer: B
solution: 规范书写要求：句首字母大写、专有名词 English 的 E 大写、陈述句末加句号；A 两处大小写错误，C 缺句号且 english 未大写，D 大小写混乱且标点错误。

stem: 制订你的周六英语学习小计划，包含听、说、读、写中至少三项活动，并写清时间（不少于 12 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：On Saturday morning, I will read a picture book for twenty minutes. In the afternoon, I will listen to English songs and sing with them. In the evening, I will write three sentences about my day.
solution: 计划=时间+活动；用 in the morning/afternoon/evening 排出时段，活动覆盖听、说、读、写中至少三项，词数达标。

stem: 用英语写 3 句连贯的话介绍你最喜欢的动物，至少用一次 and 或 because（不少于 12 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：My favourite animal is the panda. It is black and white, and it is very cute. I like it because it is lovely.
solution: 简单段落围绕一个主题：第一句点明动物，第二句写外形特征（用 and 并列），第三句用 because 说明喜欢的原因；句际用连接词才连贯。

stem: 关于课前预习英语课文，下列做法最合理的是（　　）
options: A. 预习时圈出不认识的单词，结合插图猜一猜意思，并记下看不懂的句子
B. 把课文抄写五遍就算预习
C. 不预习，等老师上课讲就行
D. 只看插图，完全不看文字
answer: A
solution: 有效预习是“带着问题读”：圈生词、借插图猜词义、记疑问点，上课时针对性听讲；B 机械抄写，C 放弃预习，D 回避文字输入，都收效甚微。

stem: 朗读 “I want THIS apple, not that one.” 时重读 THIS，是为了表达（　　）
options: A. 强调“就是这个”苹果，而不是别的
B. 表示说话人非常生气
C. 向对方提出一个问题
D. 表示说话人很难过
answer: A
solution: 重读指示词 THIS 与后面的 not that one 形成对比，突出“特指这一个”；句子重音的变化能传达强调、对比等态度。

stem: 听短文后复述大意（不少于 4 个英文词）。短文：Tom gets up at six every morning. He runs in the park for twenty minutes and then reads English aloud. He goes to school by bike. He has a healthy life. 你的复述：____
answer: 参考复述：Tom gets up early and runs in the park. Then he reads English and rides to school. He is healthy.（说出人物+主要动作+结论即可，不必逐句背诵）
solution: 复述抓“人物—主要动作—结论”链：起床→跑步→读英语→骑车上学→健康生活；用自己的话串连，词数达标。

stem: 做 1 分钟主题演讲 “My dream job”，至少 3 句（不少于 15 个英文词），要有开头和结尾：____
answer: 参考答案：Hello, everyone! My dream job is to be a doctor. I want to help sick people, because helping others makes me happy. I will study hard to make my dream come true. Thank you!
solution: 小演讲结构=问候开头—说职业与原因—表明努力方向—致谢结尾；用 because 给出理由，句数与词数达标。

stem: 写一篇日记，记录一次有趣的学校活动（不少于 4 句、20 个英文词），第一行写日期和天气：____
answer:
参考答案：
May 20th, Sunny
Today our school had a sports meeting. I ran in the 100-metre race and won second place. My classmates cheered for me loudly. I was tired but very happy. What a wonderful day!
solution: 日记要点：首行日期+天气，正文记事用过去时，按“活动—我的表现—感受”展开，末句感叹收尾。

stem: 写一段不少于 4 句（不少于 25 个英文词）的记叙文 “My First Time to Cook”，包含时间、做的事情和结果：____
answer: 参考答案：Last Sunday, I cooked dinner for the first time. I washed the vegetables and made tomato and egg soup. At first the soup was too salty, so I added some water. In the end, my parents said it was delicious and I felt proud.
solution: 记叙文按“时间—事件（过程）—结果”推进；用过去时叙事，用 at first / then / in the end 等衔接词显示顺序，词数达标。

stem: 看图：春天，几个小朋友在山坡上植树，一个男孩在挖坑，一个女孩在给小树浇水。请用 3 句话描述图片（不少于 15 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：Look! The children are planting trees on the hill. A boy is digging a hole, and a girl is watering the small tree. They are working hard and happily.
solution: 看图写话用现在进行时描述正在发生的动作：整体（孩子们植树）—细节（挖坑、浇水）—感受（干得开心），层层展开。

stem: 复习单元主题 “Weather” 时，你画了一张思维导图：中心词是 Weather，分支上已有 sunny、rainy。请再补写两个属于该主题的英文分支词：____、____
answer: windy；cloudy（或 snowy / hot / cold / warm / foggy 等任两个天气类英文单词均可）
solution: 思维导图复习法=以主题为中心，按语义场把同类词挂到分支上回忆；补写的分支词必须属于 weather 这一语义场。

stem: 做主题演讲 “Save Water, Save Lives”，至少 4 句（不少于 30 个英文词），要有开头、两条建议和结尾号召：____
answer: 参考答案：Good morning, everyone. Today I want to talk about saving water. Water is important, but many places in the world are short of water. First, we should turn off the tap after washing hands. Second, we can reuse water to clean the floor or water flowers. Let's start now and save every drop! Thank you.
solution: 演讲结构=问候—点题—问题背景—两条建议（First/Second）—号召结尾；建议要具体可做，词数达标。

stem: 写一篇日记 “A Busy Day”，不少于 4 句（不少于 30 个英文词），既写清做的事情，又写出你的感受（如 tired、happy、proud）：____
answer:
参考答案：
March 8th, Cloudy
I had a busy day today. In the morning, I helped Mum clean the house and cook lunch. In the afternoon, I did my homework and practised the piano for an hour. Although I was very tired, I felt happy because Mum said I was a great helper.
solution: 日记含日期天气；事情按时间顺序（morning/afternoon）写清，感受词（tired/happy）与原因（because...）点明情绪，体现“记事+感受”两条线。

stem: 看图：放学后，几名学生在公园里捡垃圾，有的拿着垃圾袋，有的捡起塑料瓶，旁边立着一块写着 “Keep Our Park Clean” 的牌子。请用 4 句连贯的话描述图片（不少于 30 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：After school, some students are cleaning up the park. One girl is holding a big rubbish bag, and two boys are picking up plastic bottles. There is a sign that says “Keep Our Park Clean”. They are doing a meaningful job for the environment.
solution: 描述图片按“整体—人物动作—环境细节（标语牌）—评价”的顺序；用现在进行时写动作，加入 there be 句型写细节，末句给简单评价。

stem: 语法学习要关注“形式—意义—使用”三个维度。句子 “I walked to school yesterday.” 中 walked 体现“意义”维度的是（　　）
options: A. 动词 walk 加上词尾 -ed 的形式变化
B. “走路”这一动作发生在过去
C. walked 常与 yesterday 等过去时间状语连用
D. walk 是一个表示动作的动词
answer: B
solution: 形式=词形变化（A 项 -ed）；意义=该结构表达的语义内容，即动作发生在过去（B 项）；使用=典型使用场合与常见搭配（C 项）；D 项说的是词类。

stem: 新同学 Peter 来自英国，他想了解你的学校生活。请用 4 句左右的英语向他介绍你的一天（不少于 25 个英文词），并邀请他提问：____
answer: 参考答案：Hi, Peter! Let me tell you about my school day. I usually get to school at 7:30 and have four classes in the morning. After lunch, I often play basketball with my friends. My favourite subject is English because it is fun. If you want to know anything else, just ask me!
solution: 话题交流=主动提供信息（时间顺序：到校—上课—课后）+条理清晰+结尾邀请提问，把话轮延续下去。

stem: 围绕主题 “My Favourite Food” 写 4 句意义连贯的话，至少用上 and、but、because 中的一个（不少于 25 个英文词）：____
answer: 参考答案：My favourite food is dumplings. They taste delicious, and my mum makes them every weekend. I like them because we always make them together. Dumplings mean happy family time to me.
solution: 主题句群=主题句+细节句+原因句+总结句；用 and/because 等连接词实现句际衔接，句句围绕主题，不跑题。

stem: 你的英国朋友 Amy 在你所在的城市学习。请写一张英文邀请卡，邀请她本周六上午和你一起参观博物馆，须写清时间、集合地点和活动（不少于 25 个英文词），格式：称呼+正文+署名：____
answer:
参考答案：
Dear Amy,
Would you like to visit the City Museum with me this Saturday morning? We can meet at the school gate at 9:00 and see the new dinosaur show together. I'm sure we will have a great time!
Yours,
Li Hua
solution: 邀请卡要点=邀请内容（Would you like to...）+时间+集合地点+活动安排+期待回应；格式为称呼、正文、署名三部分。

stem: 编写一个情节完整的小故事，题目 “The Lost Schoolbag”（不少于 60 个英文词），要有起因、经过和结果：____
answer: 参考答案：Last Monday afternoon, Li Ming could not find his schoolbag after basketball practice. He looked for it everywhere on the playground, but it was nowhere to be found. Just then, his classmate Wang Fang called him: “Is this your bag? I found it near the library and handed it to the teacher's office.” Li Ming hurried there and got his bag back. Everything, including his new library book, was still in it. He thanked Wang Fang warmly and learned to look after his things more carefully.
solution: 故事按“起因（丢包）—经过（寻找+同学转告）—结果（找回+感悟）”推进；用过去时叙事，加入对话使情节生动，结尾点出启示。

stem: 先正确、流利地朗读故事，再用自己的话复述大意（不少于 2 句英文）。故事：One sunny morning, a little ant found a big grain of rice by the river. The grain was too heavy for him to carry alone. So he called his friends, and hundreds of ants came. Together they pushed the rice all the way home. They were tired but happy. 你的复述：____
answer: 参考复述：A little ant found a big grain of rice but could not carry it alone. He asked his friends for help, and together they pushed it home. The story shows that teamwork makes hard things easy.
solution: 朗读时注意句子重音与连读；复述抓“主角—困难—办法—结果—道理”，用过去时转述，不必逐词背诵。

stem: 准备一段约 1 分钟的英语演讲 “My Dream”，不少于 60 个英文词，要求有吸引人的开头、两点内容和结尾号召：____
answer: 参考答案：“When I was five, I wanted to be a superhero. Now I want to be a scientist.” Good afternoon, everyone. My dream is to become a scientist, because science can change the world. To make it come true, first, I will work hard at maths and physics. Second, I will read widely and do small experiments in my spare time. Dreams are like stars — we may never touch them, but we can sail by them. Let's chase our dreams from today on! Thank you.
solution: 演讲=悬念式引语开头—点明梦想与理由—first/second 两点行动计划—引用+号召结尾；词数不少于 60，语言上口。

stem:
下面是同学的一篇作文初稿。请先指出至少 3 处语言错误并改正，再从“内容—结构—语言”三个角度各提一条修改建议。
初稿：Last Sunday. I go to the zoo with my friend Lucy. We see many animal there. The elephants are big and I like they very much. It was a fun day.
answer:
错误改正（至少 3 处）：① go → went（与 Last Sunday 保持过去时态一致）；② see → saw（同上，时态一致）；③ animal → animals（many 后接可数名词复数）；④ like they → like them（动词后用人称代词宾格）。
修改建议：内容—增加一个具体细节（如猴子表演）使文章更生动；结构—“Last Sunday.”不是完整句子，应与下句合并为 “Last Sunday, I went to the zoo...”；语言—增加衔接与感受表达，如 “What's more, the monkeys were so funny that we laughed a lot.”
solution: 修改初稿分两步：先做语言层纠错（时态一致、名词复数、代词格），再从内容、结构、语言三个维度提建议，使文章完整连贯。

stem: 英语课上老师问：“Do you think students should do sports every day?” 下列回答既清楚表达观点又给出理由的是（　　）
options: A. Yes, I think so.
B. Sorry, I don't know.
C. What sports do you like?
D. I think students should do sports every day, because exercise keeps us healthy and helps us study better.
answer: D
solution: 表达观点+理由的完整结构是“观点句 + because 理由从句”；A 只有观点没有理由，B 回避问题，C 反问转移话题。

stem: 请口头概括并转述下面这段通知的主要信息（不少于 2 句英文）。通知：Attention, please. Our school library will open a new reading room on the third floor next Monday. It holds about 2,000 new books, including popular science and English novels. Students may borrow three books at a time and keep them for two weeks. Remember to return them on time. 你的转述：____
answer: 参考转述：The school library will open a new reading room on the third floor next Monday, with about 2,000 new books. Students can borrow three books at a time and keep them for two weeks, but they must return them on time.
solution: 转述通知抓“何事—何时何地—规则（数量+期限）”；数字信息要准确，把祈使句 Remember to... 转为 but they must... 的间接转述。

stem: 你就“同学们最喜欢的运动”在班里做了调查，并画成条形图：basketball 12 人，football 8 人，swimming 6 人，running 4 人。请用 3—4 句英文为图表写一段说明文字（caption），指出最流行与最不流行的项目，并作简单评论：____
answer: 参考答案：The chart shows the favourite sports of the students in my class. Basketball is the most popular, chosen by 12 students, while running is the least popular, with only 4. Football (8) and swimming (6) come in the middle. The chart suggests that ball games attract more teenagers than individual sports.
solution: 图表说明=第一句点明图表主题→突出最大值与最小值（the most popular / the least popular）→交代中间数据→一句话评论结论；数字与比较表达要准确。

stem: 请按“起草—修改—定稿”三步独立完成 60—80 词的作文 “An Unusual Experience”：先列提纲（2 条），再写初稿，最后检查时态、拼写与衔接，写出定稿。请把提纲与定稿都写出来：____
answer:
提纲：① what happened — saw a street artist painting a huge picture on the pavement; ② why unusual — the painting disappeared in the rain, but the artist smiled and started again.
定稿（约 65 词）：Last summer, I saw something unusual on my way home. A street artist was painting a huge tiger with watercolours right on the pavement. Crowds stopped to watch and take photos. Suddenly it began to rain, and the tiger slowly disappeared. To my surprise, the artist smiled and started a new picture. That day I learned that art is worth creating even if it cannot last.
solution: 三步写作：提纲先定内容框架（事件+不寻常之处）；初稿一气呵成；修改时重点核对过去时态一致、拼写与衔接词，最后誊写定稿。
